newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Heng Fung places 129 mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: Heng Fung places 129 mln new shares.

text.p: Heng Fung Holdings Co Ltd said on Monday it has agreed to place 129 million new shares, or 15.71 percent of the enlarged share capital, to independent investors at HK$0.70 each.
The property concern said net proceeds of HK$88 million would be raised from the placement.

"It is prudent and in the commercial interests of the company to raise additional funds in order to expand its financing related business and for general working capital purposes," the company said in a statement.
The shareholding of chairman Chan Heng Fai and his wife will be diluted to 11.10 percent from 13.17 percent following the placement, it said.
Heng Fung shares were up HK$0.24 at HK$1.02 at midday.
